name: fade
description: Fade in and/or out. sox fade semantics: stop-position is where the audio is cut and the fade-out occupies [stop-position - fade_out_s, stop-position]; this recipe passes stop-position = file duration so the fade ends exactly at EOF and nothing is discarded.

params.out_format: flac|wav (default: input format; sox recipes do not write mp3)

safety: writes a NEW output under <input dir>/renders/; never overwrites the input
